import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 9.55

by K. W. Roggenkamp

Does there exist a finite $p$-group $G$ and a central augmented automorphism
$\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ such that $\varphi$, if extended to
$\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G$, the $p$-adic group ring, is *not* conjugation by a
unit in $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G$ followed by a homomorphism induced from a
group automorphism?

Here an automorphism $\varphi$ of the integral group ring $\mathbb{Z}G$ is
*augmented* if it commutes with the augmentation map
$\varepsilon \colon \mathbb{Z}G \to \mathbb{Z}$, $\sum a_g g \mapsto \sum a_g$,
and *central* if it fixes the center of $\mathbb{Z}G$ elementwise (equivalently,
it fixes every class sum). Since $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G =
\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p \otimes_{\mathbb{Z}} \mathbb{Z}G$, the automorphism
$\varphi$ has a unique $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p$-linear extension
$\widehat{\varphi}$ to $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G$.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

open MonoidAlgebra

namespace Kourovka.«9.55»

variable {G : Type*} [Group G]

/-- The augmentation map $\varepsilon \colon \mathbb{Z}G \to \mathbb{Z}$,
$\sum_g a_g g \mapsto \sum_g a_g$, i.e. the $\mathbb{Z}$-algebra homomorphism
induced by the trivial character $G \to \mathbb{Z}$, $g \mapsto 1$. -/
noncomputable def augmentation (G : Type*) [Group G] : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G →ₐ[ℤ] ℤ :=
  MonoidAlgebra.lift ℤ ℤ G 1

@[category API]
theorem augmentation_single (g : G) (a : ℤ) : augmentation G (single g a) = a := by
  simp [augmentation]

@[category test]
theorem augmentation_single_one_one (g : G) : augmentation G (single g 1) = 1 :=
  augmentation_single g 1

/-- A ring automorphism $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ is *augmented* if it commutes with the
augmentation map $\varepsilon \colon \mathbb{Z}G \to \mathbb{Z}$, i.e.
$\varepsilon \circ \varphi = \varepsilon$. -/
def IsAugmented (φ : RingAut (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, augmentation G (φ x) = augmentation G x

/-- A ring automorphism $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ is *central* if it fixes the center of
$\mathbb{Z}G$ elementwise. -/
def IsCentral (φ : RingAut (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)) : Prop :=
  ∀ z ∈ Subring.center (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G), φ z = z

@[category test]
theorem isAugmented_refl : IsAugmented (RingEquiv.refl (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)) := fun _ => rfl

@[category test]
theorem isCentral_refl : IsCentral (RingEquiv.refl (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)) := fun _ _ => rfl

/-- The automorphism of $\mathbb{Z}G$ induced by a group automorphism is augmented. -/
@[category API]
theorem isAugmented_domCongr (σ : MulAut G) : IsAugmented (domCongr ℤ ℤ σ).toRingEquiv := by
  intro x
  have : (augmentation G).comp (domCongr ℤ ℤ σ).toAlgHom = augmentation G := by
    apply MonoidAlgebra.algHom_ext
    intro g
    simp [augmentation]
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun this x

/-- The inclusion $\mathbb{Z}G \to \widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G$ of the integral group ring into the
$p$-adic group ring, induced by $\mathbb{Z} \to \widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p$ on coefficients. -/
noncomputable def toPadic (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type*) [Group G] :
    MonoidAlgebra ℤ G →+* MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G :=
  mapRangeRingHom G (Int.castRingHom ℤ_[p])

/-- The unique $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p$-linear extension $\widehat{\varphi}$ of a ring
automorphism $\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ to the $p$-adic group ring
$\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G$: it sends $\sum_g a_g g$ (with $a_g \in \widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p$)
to $\sum_g a_g \varphi(g)$. -/
noncomputable def padicExtension (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (φ : RingAut (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)) :
    MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G :=
  MonoidAlgebra.lift ℤ_[p] (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G) G <|
    ((toPadic p G).toMonoidHom.comp φ.toRingHom.toMonoidHom).comp (of ℤ G)

/-- The $p$-adic extension $\widehat{\varphi}$ of $\varphi$ agrees with $\varphi$ on
$\mathbb{Z}G \subseteq \widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G$. -/
@[category API]
theorem padicExtension_toPadic (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (φ : RingAut (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G))
    (x : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) :
    padicExtension p φ (toPadic p G x) = toPadic p G (φ x) := by
  have : (padicExtension p φ).toRingHom.comp (toPadic p G) = (toPadic p G).comp φ.toRingHom := by
    apply MonoidAlgebra.ringHom_ext
    · intro b
      have hb : (single 1 b : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) = (b : MonoidAlgebra ℤ G) := by
        rw [intCast_def, Int.cast_id]
      simp [hb, map_intCast]
    · intro a
      simp [padicExtension, toPadic]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun this x

/--
Does there exist a finite $p$-group $G$ and a central augmented automorphism $\varphi$ of
$\mathbb{Z}G$ such that $\varphi$, if extended to $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G$, the $p$-adic group
ring, is *not* conjugation by a unit in $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G$ followed by a homomorphism
induced from a group automorphism?

That is, is there a prime $p$, a finite $p$-group $G$ and a central augmented automorphism
$\varphi$ of $\mathbb{Z}G$ such that there are no unit $u \in \widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G$ and
group automorphism $\sigma \in \operatorname{Aut}(G)$ with
$\widehat{\varphi}(x) = \widehat{\sigma}(u x u^{-1})$ for all
$x \in \widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G$, where $\widehat{\varphi}$ is the
$\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p$-linear extension of $\varphi$ and $\widehat{\sigma}$ is the
automorphism of $\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}_p G$ induced by $\sigma$?
-/
@[category research open, AMS 16 20]
theorem kourovka.«9.55» : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∃ (p : ℕ) (_ : Fact p.Prime) (G : Type) (_ : Group G) (_ : Finite G), IsPGroup p G ∧
      ∃ φ : RingAut (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G), IsAugmented φ ∧ IsCentral φ ∧
        ¬ ∃ (u : (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G)ˣ) (σ : MulAut G),
          ∀ x, padicExtension p φ x = domCongr ℤ_[p] ℤ_[p] σ (↑u * x * ↑u⁻¹) := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«9.55»

modeling_decisions: 'central automorphism' is read in the Roggenkamp–Scott sense: φ fixes the center of ℤG elementwise (`∀ z ∈ Subring.center (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G), φ z = z`), equivalently fixes all class sums — not the group-theoretic notion of a central automorphism of a group.
'augmented automorphism' is read as ε ∘ φ = ε where ε = `MonoidAlgebra.lift ℤ ℤ G 1` is the augmentation Σ a_g g ↦ Σ a_g.
'automorphism of ℤG' is taken as a ring automorphism `RingAut (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)`; since ℤ is initial this coincides with ℤ-algebra automorphisms.

The extension of φ to the p-adic group ring is defined explicitly as the ℤ_[p]-algebra hom `MonoidAlgebra.lift ℤ_[p] (ℤ_[p][G]) G (g ↦ ι(φ(g)))` where ι : ℤG → ℤ_[p]G is `mapRangeRingHom` along `Int.castRingHom`. This is the unique ℤ_p-linear extension (ℤ_pG = ℤ_p ⊗ ℤG); the API lemma `padicExtension_toPadic` proves it agrees with φ on ℤG.

'conjugation by unit in ℤ_pG followed by a homomorphism induced from a group automorphism' is stated literally in that order: φ̂ x = σ̂(u * x * u⁻¹) with u : (MonoidAlgebra ℤ_[p] G)ˣ (unit of ℤ_p[G] itself, not ℚ_p[G]) and σ̂ = `MonoidAlgebra.domCongr ℤ_[p] ℤ_[p] σ` for σ : MulAut G. Using u x u⁻¹ vs u⁻¹ x u, or the other composition order, gives the same set of automorphisms.
The prime p is quantified existentially via `∃ (p : ℕ) (_ : Fact p.Prime)`, which both supplies the instance needed for ℤ_[p] and rules out degenerate `IsPGroup 0 G` (which holds for every group).
G is quantified over `Type` (universe 0), following the other Kourovka files; this loses nothing for an existence statement about finite groups.
Status kept as `research open` with `answer(sorry)`, as instructed; Roggenkamp–Scott's later results on p-adic group rings of p-groups are not baked in.
